description: Form-associated calendar date picker with combobox text entry

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. A name on the inner input (the no-JS path) moves here on upgrade so exactly one value submits; the host's own name wins if both are set.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the text input and calendar button, closes the calendar and drops the value from submission. A disabled ancestor fieldset has the same effect. A disabled on the inner input moves here on upgrade.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Makes a date required (valueMissing). Observed at runtime; a required on the inner input works too.

attributes.name: data-disabled-dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated ISO dates to disable (optionally with reason: "2026-04-05:booked"). Disabled days stay keyboard-focusable but cannot be selected.

attributes.name: data-highlight-dates
attributes.description: Comma-separated ISO dates to highlight (optionally with category: "2026-12-25:holiday"). Highlighted days remain selectable.

attributes.name: data-label-toggle
attributes.description: Accessible name for the calendar icon button (default "Toggle calendar").

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name for the calendar popup (default "Choose date").

attributes.name: data-label-prev
attributes.description: Accessible name for the previous-month button (default "Previous month").

attributes.name: data-label-next
attributes.description: Accessible name for the next-month button (default "Next month").

attributes.name: data-label-year
attributes.description: Accessible name for the year select (default "Year").

attributes.name: data-label-placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder for the text input (default "Type a date…").

attributes.name: data-label-required
attributes.description: Validation message when required and empty (default "Please select a date").

attributes.name: data-label-range-underflow
attributes.default: Choose a date on or after {date}
attributes.description: Validation message when the value is before min; {date} is replaced by the formatted min. A data-message-rangeunderflow on the inner input wins.

attributes.name: data-label-range-overflow
attributes.default: Choose a date on or before {date}
attributes.description: Validation message when the value is after max; {date} is replaced by the formatted max. A data-message-rangeoverflow on the inner input wins.

attributes.name: data-label-input
attributes.description: Accessible name for the text input when neither a <label> nor an aria-label/aria-labelledby is present (default "Date").

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Reflected while the calendar is open

events.name: date-picker:change
events.description: Fired when the selected date changes (not on form reset/restore). value is the ISO string ('' when cleared), date a Date or null. source is 'api' for .value assignments, 'pointer' for grid clicks, 'keyboard' for grid Enter/Space and typed commits.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Get or set the selected date as an ISO string (YYYY-MM-DD). Assigning '' or null clears; malformed or impossible dates (2026-02-31) are ignored.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Get or set the earliest selectable date (ISO). Updates the calendar and validity immediately; a current value before it is kept and flagged rangeUnderflow.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Get or set the latest selectable date (ISO). Updates the calendar and validity immediately; a current value after it is kept and flagged rangeOverflow.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: Current validity, owned by the host: valueMissing (required and empty), rangeUnderflow (before min), rangeOverflow (after max). Anchored on the text input.

properties.name: willValidate
properties.description: Whether the element is a candidate for constraint validation

methods.name: checkValidity()
methods.description: Run constraint validation without showing UI

methods.name: reportValidity()
methods.description: Run constraint validation and show the browser message, anchored on the text input

childAttributes.name: value
childAttributes.description: Initial date (ISO). The value attribute is the form-reset target.

childAttributes.name: name
childAttributes.description: Submission name for the no-JS fallback. Moved to the host on upgrade.

structure.description: Required. Supplies value/min/max and is the no-JS fallback. Its <label for> (or a <label for> on the host, or an aria-label) names the generated combobox.
